description: E2B is a cloud platform that gives AI agents secure, isolated sandboxes — ephemeral Linux VMs with a filesystem, package managers, and internet access — to run AI-generated code safely. Use when a user wants an agent to execute Python or JavaScript, install packages, read/write files, or run a long process without risking the host machine, or wants to wire code execution into a LangChain, CrewAI, or custom agent loop.
